The '''''Dominance''''' was an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] serving the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The ''Dominance'' was dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]], in an effort to prevent a [[Battle of Jabiim|secessionist war]].
